items.title: John Fedchock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 28, 2015
items.q: Bill Watrous’s influence is is Carl Fontana... I was really getting into him... I kind of put him up on a pedestal for quite a long time, really trying to get close to his way of phrasing.

ctx.x: Unmistakable within the first couple of measures, that was Bill Watrous.
